_comment: MAY did not read its `cost`, so the prompt was FREE and the bonus unconditional -- the card was strictly stronger than printed. The cost also tapped the WRONG CARD: 'you may {t} an ALLY you control' was TAP_SELF, which taps the source, and its 'target':'ALLY' was unread -- so Hoist 'Em Up tapped itself and got +1{d} regardless of whether the player had an ally at all.
